usedFor: Slide holds contacts, and “When a new contact is created” starts “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is created” in Slide, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact lands as a row in an Excel table, so your list stays in sheet form.

watchOut: “Update Row” needs a row that already exists, so use “Add Row To Table” for new contacts.
